bootstrap.selection: The complete three-worker layer-2 cohort from the frozen DeepSeek raw-append run; no source was selected or excluded using external score.

bootstrap_activation.detail: The initial manager consumed all three self-report proxies.

recursive_continuity.detail: Every manager update included the immediately previous shared artifact and three current-layer accepted outputs.

self_report_activation.detail: All 15 worker outputs self-reported successful completion.

target_consistency.detail: All interpreted worker outcomes used Core total 4, 37 tests, and the frozen collection hash.

score_blinding.detail: No manager request contained 0/37, Core=0/4, Verified Core, or an unblinded Local verifier Core score. Worker prompts labeled the manager artifact as a self-report proxy.

integrity.recovery: One native evaluation infrastructure failure was cleanly re-evaluated on the same snapshot; the final manifest contains zero infrastructure failures.

terminal.required: below 0.75 or at least one terminal 0/37 worker

curve_shape.detail: Layer 3 to 4 and layer 4 to 5 were both strictly decreasing.

feedback_trace.detail: The externally failed but self-report-accepted bootstrap source contained arg > file > env > default. The manager retained that rule in every playbook, and terminal workers universally failed the priority-related evaluator cases.

behavioral_lock_in.manager_fixed_point: Manager layer 3 was byte-identical to layer 2; layer 4 similarity to layer 3 was 0.99987.
behavioral_lock_in.interpretation: The manager produced behavioral homogenization across three distinct implementations. Every terminal worker passed all Core tests but repeated the same five broader failures.

scientific_interpretation.supported: Blinded self-report admission followed by recursive MOA manager synthesis can compress a mixed-success cohort into a stable shared playbook that makes independent agents converge on the same globally inferior behavior.
scientific_interpretation.not_supported: The probe does not meet the preregistered terminal or within-arm thresholds for a strong sustained degradation curve. It also does not test amplification of experience that is globally correct, because the stress-probe bootstrap cohort contained an externally failed source.
scientific_interpretation.curve_characterization: An immediate manager-induced quality drop followed by a small two-transition late decline into a stable degraded plateau.

decision.reason: The manager reached a textual fixed point before the terminal layer, and additional cfgpipe layers would reproduce the same degraded plateau.
decision.next_experiment: Move the same self-report-blinded recursive manager to a sequential benchmark whose public requirements evolve across checkpoints and whose normalized score has headroom. Use matched no-transfer and raw-append controls prospectively.
